messages.text: The Lantern Festival begins at 19:00 UTC in Amber Square.
Volunteers placed 40 lanterns around Amber Square.
Pax will open the east entrance.
Bring empty jars to the return table.

product.title: Region 28 Dispatch
product.subtitle: Logistics and preparations for the upcoming festival.

main_story.headline: Preparations Finalized for Amber Square Lantern Festival
main_story.lede: Community members coordinated logistics for the *Lantern Festival*, including timing, inventory placement, and site access.
main_story.body:
The discussion centered on the organizational requirements for the *Lantern Festival* beginning at 19:00 UTC in Amber Square. **Oren** confirmed that volunteers have placed 40 lanterns around the area to facilitate the event.

Access protocols were also established by **Nora**. She noted that Pax will open the east entrance, while the west entrance remains closed. Additionally, she instructed participants to bring empty jars to the return table.
